AkaiLinn.label: Crunchy 12-bit Linn punch, dry and tight
AkaiLinn.about: Punchy, dry, slightly crunchy 12-bit Linn drums. Mid-forward snare, tight kick. You want LinnDrum punch with a bit more grit and less polish.

AkaiMPC60.label: Warm 12-bit boom-bap crunch, the hip-hop MPC
AkaiMPC60.kind: Akai MPC60 (1988, 12-bit sampler, Roger Linn design)
AkaiMPC60.about: The hip-hop sound: warm, thick 12-bit crunch, rounded lows, snares with body. Boom-bap, lo-fi hip-hop, anything that should feel sampled off vinyl.

AkaiXR10.label: Clean bright early-90s digital, big variant set
AkaiXR10.about: Clean, bright, early-90s digital. Lots of kick/snare variants, big perc set. You want a polished house/pop kit with plenty of choice per voice.

AlesisHR16.label: Crisp glassy late-80s digital, snappy and thin
AlesisHR16.about: Crisp, glassy, slightly brittle late-80s digital. Snappy snare, thin hats. Synth-pop, freestyle, new-jack-swing era sheen.

AlesisSR16.label: Neutral realistic rock/pop drums, many variants
AlesisSR16.about: Realistic, neutral, rock/pop "real drums in a box". Many kick and snare choices. You want acoustic-sounding drums that sit in a mix without a personality.

BossDR110.label: Small clicky analog, thin and ticky, 606 cousin
BossDR110.about: Small, clicky, boxy analog. Thin kick, clappy snare, ticky hats. Cousin of the TR-606. Minimal, lo-fi electro, bedroom-synth-pop.

BossDR220.label: Grainy cardboardy 80s sample-box, cute and short
BossDR220.about: Cheap 80s sample-box: slightly grainy, short, cardboardy, cute. Lo-fi 80s pop, indie electronic, "toy drum machine" vibe.

BossDR55.label: Tiny papery 1979 analog, primitive minimal wave
BossDR55.about: Tiny, thin, first-ever Dr. Rhythm. Papery kick, white-noise snare, faint hats. Post-punk, minimal wave, deliberately primitive beats.

BossDR550.label: Polite clean early-90s ROM drums, safe default
BossDR550.about: Clean, generic, early-90s ROM drums with a decent perc set. Polite and safe. Pop or R&B sketch that just needs competent drums.

CasioRZ1.label: Bright aliased 12-bit crunch, snappy electro bite
CasioRZ1.about: Bright, crunchy, aliased 12-bit. Thin snappy snare, harsh cymbals. Electro, freestyle, lo-fi house; when you want digital bite.

CasioSK1.label: Hissy 8-bit toy drums, deliberately cheap
CasioSK1.about: Very lo-fi 8-bit toy drums, hissy and fuzzy, tiny transients. Chiptune-adjacent, bedroom lo-fi, deliberately cheap.

CasioVL1.label: Beepy calculator-toy clicks, Da Da Da minimal
CasioVL1.about: Three beepy, clicky toy hits. Barely drums. The "Da Da Da" machine. Novelty, micro-beats, kraftwerk-style minimalism.

DoepferMS404.label: Fat synth-patched analog: sub kick, noisy snare
DoepferMS404.about: Fat synthesized analog hits: round sub kick, noisy snare. Not a drum machine. Techno/acid where drums should sound like a synth.

EmuDrumulator.label: Chunky gritty 8-bit new-wave thud and crack
EmuDrumulator.about: Chunky, gritty 8-bit; thuddy kick, cracking snare, grainy hats. New-wave staple. Early-80s new wave, synth-pop, coldwave with grit.

EmuSP12.label: Dusty punchy 12-bit hip-hop, deep kick/snare set
EmuSP12.about: The other hip-hop sampler: dusty, punchy, mid-heavy 12-bit. Huge kick/snare variety. Golden-era hip-hop, dusty breaks, sample-flavoured beats.

KorgDDM110.label: Harsh cheap 80s PCM, clicky and sizzly
KorgDDM110.about: Cheap, harsh, lo-fi PCM; sharp clicky kick, sizzly hats. Lo-fi electro, minimal techno wanting a nasty edge.

KorgKPR77.label: Soft round analog, gentle 606-like box
KorgKPR77.about: Soft, boxy analog, TR-606 territory but rounder. Minimal synth, dub-ish patterns, gentle analog beats.

KorgKR55.label: Warm woody 70s analog preset thump
KorgKR55.kind: Korg KR-55 Rhythm 55 (1979, analog preset box)
KorgKR55.about: Warm, thumpy, slightly woody analog; snare like a brushed tick. Organ-lounge, krautrock, retro-lounge beats.

KorgKRZ.label: Plain digital hits with a couple of fx sounds
KorgKRZ.kind: Korg KRZ (sample set of uncertain origin; includes fx)
KorgKRZ.about: Digital 90s-style hits plus two fx sounds. Cleanish, unremarkable. You want a plain digital kit with a couple of built-in fx hits.

KorgM1.label: Clean bright 1990 house kit, iconic M1 hits
KorgM1.about: The 1990 house/pop sound: clean, bright, slightly hollow. Big misc set (the famous M1 hits). Classic house, early-90s pop, anything "piano house".

KorgMinipops.label: Bouncy 60s organ-box tick-tock, Oxygène rhythm
KorgMinipops.about: Tiny, bouncy, organ-box tick-tock. The Jean-Michel Jarre "Oxygène" rhythm. Kosmische, exotica, lounge, retro-futurist minimal.

KorgT3.label: M1-style clean bright ROM, alternate snares
KorgT3.about: M1 successor: same clean bright ROM character, a few more variants. Like the M1 but you want slightly different snares.

Linn9000.label: Big polished mid-80s Linn punch, fuller
Linn9000.about: Big, punchy, polished mid-80s Linn; fuller than LinnDrum. Big-80s pop, power ballads, gated-drum era.

LinnDrum.label: Tight cracking 80s pop drums, Prince-era Linn
LinnDrum.about: THE 80s pop kit: tight kick, cracking snare, crisp hats. Prince, Hall & Oates. Anything 80s pop/funk/synth-pop.

LinnLM1.label: Dry raw early-80s Linn, slappy new-wave snare
LinnLM1.kind: Linn LM-1 (1980, 8-bit, first sampled drum machine)
LinnLM1.about: Drier, thinner, rawer than LinnDrum; rounded kick, slappy snare. Early-80s new wave, Human League / Gary Numan textures.

LinnLM2.label: LinnDrum family with extra kick/snare picks
LinnLM2.about: Same LinnDrum family, more kick/snare variants, slightly different tuning. You like LinnDrum but want to pick among snares.

MFB512.label: Boxy fizzy German analog, cold minimal wave
MFB512.about: Boxy, midrange-y analog; tight kick, fizzy snare, almost lo-fi. Minimal wave, cold German electro, DIY synth.

MPC1000.label: Modern clean punchy MPC hip-hop, no grit
MPC1000.about: Modern, clean, punchy sampler defaults; contemporary hip-hop kit. Modern trap/hip-hop sketches without vintage grit.

OberheimDMX.label: Hard crunchy 8-bit thump, Run-DMC / New Order
OberheimDMX.about: Hard, crunchy 8-bit thump; the Run-DMC / New Order kit. Big kick, dry crack snare. Old-school hip-hop, electro, new wave with punch.

RhythmAce.label: Soft 60s organ-box bossa ticks, lounge exotica
RhythmAce.kind: Ace Tone Rhythm Ace (late 60s/70s preset box)
RhythmAce.about: Soft organ-box bossa-nova ticks, congas and cowbell-ish perc. Lounge exotica. Exotica, bossa, retro lounge, hauntology.

RolandCompurhythm1000.label: Tighter cleaner late CompuRhythm, mid-80s pop
RolandCompurhythm1000.about: Late CompuRhythm: tighter, cleaner than CR-78, a bit generic. Mid-80s pop demos, clean analog-ish without 808 clichés.

RolandCompurhythm78.label: Soft woody vintage analog, In the Air Tonight
RolandCompurhythm78.about: Soft, woody, vintage analog; bossa/rhumba perc. Phil Collins "In the Air Tonight". Vintage pop, lounge, soft-focus retro, Blondie-era.

RolandCompurhythm8000.label: Warm analog between CR-78 and 808, disco-ready
RolandCompurhythm8000.about: Between CR-78 and 808: warm analog, bigger kick, clap. Warm analog pop/disco that isn't a straight 808.

RolandD110.label: Grainy thin LA-synth digital, late-80s sheen
RolandD110.about: Slightly grainy LA-synthesis PCM; thin, bright, 80s-digital. Late-80s sophisti-pop, sample-and-hold digital sheen.

RolandD70.label: Clean fuller early-90s ROM, ballad-ready
RolandD70.about: Clean early-90s ROM drums, slightly fuller than D-110. Early-90s pop/R&B ballad drums.

RolandJD990.label: Lush processed 90s hi-fi, layered kicks/snares
RolandJD990.about: Hi-fi, lush, very-90s: processed kicks, layered snares, lots of variants. 90s trance/downtempo/jungle-era polish.

RolandMC303.label: Everything 90s dance: 808/909 clones, huge perc
RolandMC303.about: 808/909/CR emulations plus 90s dance perc. Biggest general-purpose set here. Dance/techno/jungle sketching with one kit that has everything.

RolandMT32.label: Thin crunchy DOS-game drums, cute LA-synth
RolandMT32.about: The DOS-game soundtrack drums: thin, crunchy, slightly cute LA-synth. Retro-game, vaporwave, cheap-charming late-80s.

RolandR8.label: Clean articulate 16-bit acoustic, rich toms
RolandR8.about: Clean, realistic, articulate 16-bit; lots of tom/snare variants. Acoustic-flavoured pop/rock/fusion with detail.

RolandSystem100.label: Raw modular analog: subs, noise, bleeps, weird
RolandSystem100.about: Raw modular analog: sub kicks, noise bursts, bleeps. Huge, weird set. Techno, industrial, experimental; synth-drum design.

RolandTR505.label: Thin cheap 80s PCM 909-lite with latin perc
RolandTR505.about: Thin, bright, cheap 80s PCM 909-lite; latin perc. Lo-fi house, freestyle, budget-80s.

RolandTR606.label: Small tight sizzly analog, acid/minimal
RolandTR606.about: Small, tight, sizzly analog: clicky kick, snappy snare, tinny hats. Acid, minimal techno, sparse electro.

RolandTR626.label: Cleaner punchier 505 with more latin perc
RolandTR626.about: 505's bigger sibling: cleaner, more perc, slightly more punch. Latin-flavoured house, late-80s pop.

RolandTR707.label: Crisp dry 80s PCM, Chicago house workhorse
RolandTR707.about: Crisp, dry, midrange PCM; the house-music workhorse before the 909 was cheap. Chicago house, early acid house, boxy dry beats.

RolandTR808.label: Booming sub kick, snappy snare, cowbell classic
RolandTR808.about: Deep booming kick, snappy snare, ticky hats, cowbell. Many tunings per voice. Hip-hop, trap, electro, Miami bass, anything sub-heavy.

RolandTR909.label: Punchy pumping kick, techno/house standard
RolandTR909.about: Punchy pumping kick, cracking snare, sampled hats. The techno/house standard. (default kit) Techno, house, anything four-on-the-floor.

SakataDPM48.label: Obscure grainy 8-bit punch, harsh edges
SakataDPM48.about: Obscure Japanese 8-bit: grainy, punchy, a little harsh. Lo-fi electro that isn't the usual DMX/Linn.

SequentialCircuitsDrumtracks.label: Bright metallic 8-bit synth-pop punch
SequentialCircuitsDrumtracks.about: Bright, punchy, slightly metallic 8-bit; synth-pop sheen. Mid-80s synth-pop, Depeche-ish drums.

SequentialCircuitsTom.label: Bright 8-bit synth-pop, smaller palette
SequentialCircuitsTom.about: DrumTraks' cheaper sibling: similar bright 8-bit, fewer voices. Same as DrumTraks with a smaller palette.

SimmonsSDS5.label: Synthetic 80s pew toms and thwack snare
SimmonsSDS5.about: The hexagonal-pad 80s sound: "pew" toms, electronic thwack snare, synthetic kick. Big-80s drama, synthwave, Duran Duran fills.

SoundmastersR88.label: Thin cheap 80s analog, papery minimal
SoundmastersR88.about: Thin, cheap DR-55-alike analog; papery and minimal. Minimal wave, DIY post-punk.

UnivoxMicroRhythmer12.label: Four tiny 70s organ-box hits, soft and hissy
UnivoxMicroRhythmer12.about: Four tiny organ-box hits: soft thump, tick, hiss. Ultra-minimal retro, lounge, kraut.

ViscoSpaceDrum.label: Zappy swept synth drums, space disco lasers
ViscoSpaceDrum.kind: Visco Space Drum (80s analog percussion synth)
ViscoSpaceDrum.about: Simmons-like synthetic drums: swept toms, zappy kicks, laser hits. Space disco, italo, sci-fi synth drums.

XdrumLM8953.label: Generic mid-80s PCM, neutral and unassuming
XdrumLM8953.about: Generic mid-80s PCM: clean-ish, slightly crunchy, unremarkable. A neutral 80s digital kit that isn't a famous name.

YamahaRM50.label: Huge 16-bit library, hundreds of every voice
YamahaRM50.about: Enormous 16-bit library: acoustic, electronic, processed. Anything, many times. You want to dig for a specific kick/snare among hundreds.

YamahaRX21.label: Cheap crunchy boxy 80s PCM, thin and short
YamahaRX21.about: Cheap, crunchy, boxy 80s PCM; thin snare, short hats. Budget-80s pop, lo-fi synth-pop.

YamahaRX5.label: Punchy bright tunable 12-bit, late-80s hits
YamahaRX5.about: Punchy, bright, tunable 12-bit; the "house of RX" hits. Late-80s hip-hop/house, Cameo-style pop.

YamahaRY30.label: Clean big early-90s digital, broad variants
YamahaRY30.about: Clean, big, tweakable early-90s digital; broad variant set. Early-90s R&B/pop/dance with a polished kit.
